tasks.title: Fix bottom-half slab height on pitched roofs (odd steps sit half a block too low)
tasks.notes: Follow-up to #207 (merged 5d7dbb2) after independent review found a geometry blocker; I-019 (S-068, S-069). Cause, checked by arithmetic: pitched_roof_states / roof placement put an odd half-height h at y = h//2 as a bottom-half slab, surface y+0.5, which is lower than the full block for h-1 at the same y (surface y+1). A slope h=12..16 gives surfaces 7, 6.5, 8, 7.5, 9, a sawtooth. Deliver: odd h places the bottom-half slab one block up, y = (h+1)//2 (surface y+1.5): slope surfaces 7, 7.5, 8, 8.5, 9. Even h unchanged; stair same-Y rule (#169) stays consistent (use one helper such as roof_block_y for every half-height to y mapping: pitched_roof_states, zone_roof ~1540/1548, roof_pitched placement ~2418, ~1706, ~2421). A slab must not float: put a wall block under it when the cell below is air. Also fix review nits: pitched_roof_states docstring still says top slab for 2*y+1; new names/comments use 'bottom-half slab' (GLOSSARY.md Blocks; do not rename old identifiers, that is #208); stale keep_bottom_slabs warnings in lib/site/site_kit.py (~1063, ~1068) now that McpWriter places every bottom-half slab; drop getattr on keep_slab_cells; prune keep_slab_cells when a later set/fill overwrites the cell if small; McpWriter slab placement checks the call result and fails loudly; one line in rules/slow-commands.md (one block_set_state per slab at ~1.1 s, 500 slabs about 9 min); lib/audit/floaters.py post_on_half_block flags posts on type=bottom slabs, which is correct, no change. Tests: update test_stair_run_ending_in_low_step and valley/ridge tests; ADD monotone-surface test over h=12..16 and a slab-has-solid-below test; ADD McpWriter test (slabs after fills, replay path with only Writes.cells and empty keep_slab_cells, call arguments). Files: lib/builds/feature_build.py, lib/builds/test_feature_build.py, lib/site/site_kit.py, lib/site/test_site_kit_slabs.py, rules/slow-commands.md. Not verified: block_set_state accepting string property values on the live server; journal readback of roof slab cells. Checks: run_tests.py --only test_feature_build and test_site_kit_slabs pass; after a rebuild of w146985470 and west_w34391673, block_scan_region of the roof shows bottom-half slabs one block above the lower full block, rising steadily, none floating (S-068, S-069).
